# Machines & Cloud

> Stop losing jobs to the shop that answered first. Machines & Cloud builds an AI front desk for Houston home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning): it answers calls, texts, and website chat within a minute, states only published fees, books the visit into the owner's calendar with reminders and on-the-way texts, and follows up on reviews, open quotes, quiet leads, and payments, with emergency rules by trade, Spanish on every channel, a Monday report of what it answered and booked, a list of numbers that always ring through to the owner, and follow-up texts only between 9 am and 9 pm. Three plans by call minutes, setup included, no setup fee, first 7 days free, no contract: Starter $99 a month (150 minutes, 500 texts), Growth $249 a month (600 minutes, 1,500 texts, review, quote, lead, and payment follow-up texts), Pro $449 a month (1,500 minutes, 5,000 texts, custom rules, several crews, maintenance reminders to customers who opt in). Over the included amounts: $0.35 a minute, $0.03 a text. Founder led, Houston based.
